name: mission-complete-burst
intent: Four telemetry widgets collapse in fixed order; COMPLETE / RANK A slams in as an angular stamp panel.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Widgets hidden and COMPLETE / RANK A stamp appears immediately; no collapse or stamp animation

acceptance: Idle: four telemetry widgets visible; burst panel hidden
FINALIZE collapses widgets in order ALT→SPD→OBJ→SIG with 40ms stagger over 420ms each
After 400ms delay, angular COMPLETE stamp slams in over 360ms (clip-path, no soft glow)
Done: COMPLETE and RANK A visible; widgets hidden; live announces rank
RESET restores idle widgets and hides burst
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows stamp immediately without collapse
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: Frozen collapse order/stagger; angular stamp via clip-path rotation, not scale glow
